name: F1
requested_by: owner (chat, 2026-10-15: "setup this than and test it" for the forward record of flipped-level touches)
source: results/E1/report.md: 15m first touches of confirmed flipped levels beat random levels by +0.026/+0.025/+0.065 (train) and +0.025/+0.019/+0.028 (validation) at lookbacks 3/5/10, all inside the intervals. No candle after the forward start was looked at before this file was committed.

primary.level_type: flipped (first touch after the confirming retest)

secondary: 15m lookbacks 3 and 5, 1H and 4H at lookback 10, fresh levels: reported, never decided on
measure: win = price reaches 1 ATR away from the level before 1 ATR through it within 32 candles (touch candle's adverse extreme counts, its favourable one does not); against 3 random levels per touch at the same side and distance from price (event_study.control_events)

criteria.no_edge: 90% weekly-block bootstrap interval of win(real) - win(random) reaches zero
criteria.edge_not_tradeable: interval above zero, but win(real) < 0.5 + cost_atr / 2 (a 1:1 trade with a 1 ATR stop does not cover one spread plus slippage)
criteria.edge: interval above zero and win(real) >= 0.5 + cost_atr / 2

note: At E1's rate (about 135 primary touches a year) the verdict needs about three years. Interim reports are tallies, not evidence; the criteria are applied once, when 400 touches are resolved.
